quantity_rule: Family quotas48/8/8 scale with actual capacity/64; these are representative volume conventions, not inventory capacity partitions. Stable deficit cell ownership; q+F_family^4*(1-q); midpoint prefix ranking.
alpha_geometry_limit: 8x8 sampled source proxy with one-texel alpha-mask dilation, not a proof covering every visible native texel. Raw native renderer meshes/materials remain unchanged and are not shipped.

checks.crate_all_kind_cell_combinations: full-height disjoint cylinders at >=4mm separation; within-cell same-kind support checked
checks.standing_evidence: evidence/prefix-checks.json, contact-checks.json and native-probe.json. Final acceptance and all limitations: READY.md.

native_internal_overlaps: See standing-native-audit.json; unchanged game-template internal overlaps are separate from placement-induced intersections.
